title: Sources & further reading
body:
Transit: JR West, Nankai Electric Railway, Kintetsu Railway, Surutto Kansai (Kansai Railway Pass Lite).

Entry & money: Japan National Tourism Organization (JNTO), Seven Bank, XE currency converter.

Sights: Kiyomizu-dera, Fushimi Inari Taisha, Tenryu-ji, Todai-ji, Kasuga Taisha, Osaka Castle, Visit Nara, Toji, Nanzenji.

Food: Mizuno, Kushikatsu Daruma, Kouga-ryu, Houshoan, Nishiki Market Shopping Street Promotion Association.

Etiquette: Kansai Television (KTV) coverage of the Gion private-road entry ban.

A few figures above — the JR Nara Line fare and a couple of food picks' exact hours — rest on aggregator corroboration rather than a directly fetched official page; see the ⚠ flags on those items before locking plans around them. Osaka/Kyoto/Nara crowd-timing, tourist-trap and quiet-alternative notes throughout draw on independent Japanese-language resident blogs (note.com, hatenablog, and local guide sites), corroborated in pairs where used as fact rather than color.
